description: A self-drawing curved line (default red) connecting two endpoints. Built for the 'curvy line leading from one asset to another' recipe: declare fromAssetId + toAssetId in contentOverride and pass 2's resolveSceneRefs writes both endpoints' centers into content.points. The component turns those two points into a smooth cubic-bezier curve by offsetting the control points perpendicular to the segment, so it actually bows rather than being a straight diagonal. The line draws itself in via stroke-dashoffset over drawDurationFraction of its active window, then holds.

fromAssetId.description: Connector shorthand: id of an asset resolved earlier in this scene. Pass 2 books `{ followAssetId: <fromAssetId>, anchorEdge: fromEdge }` for endpoint[0] and resolves it through the same anchor templating resolver the rest of the framework uses (src/templating/anchor.js). See `points` below for the full endpoint vocabulary. Overrides explicit `points[0]`.

fromEdge.description: Which point on the fromAssetId target's OWN box the line originates from. Default 'center'. Use e.g. 'bottom' to leave from the bottom edge of a text block instead of cutting through its middle.

fromOffsetXPercent.description: Composition-space % nudge applied after resolving fromEdge.

fromOffsetYPercent.description: Composition-space % nudge applied after resolving fromEdge.

toAssetId.description: Connector shorthand: id of an asset resolved earlier in this scene. Pass 2 books `{ followAssetId: <toAssetId>, anchorEdge: toEdge }` for endpoint[1] and resolves it through the anchor templating resolver (src/templating/anchor.js). Overrides explicit `points[1]`.

toEdge.description: Which point on the toAssetId target's OWN box the line arrives at. Default 'center'.

toOffsetXPercent.description: Composition-space % nudge applied after resolving toEdge.

toOffsetYPercent.description: Composition-space % nudge applied after resolving toEdge.

points.description:
Two endpoints. Each item is authored in the anchor templating vocabulary (the SAME shape `cameraAnchor` accepts in camera.schema.json), NOT exact composition-space pixels:
  - { position: 'top-left'|'center'|... , offsetXPercent?, offsetYPercent? } — named composition-frame corner + composition-space % nudge.
  - { followAssetId, anchorEdge?, offsetXPercent?, offsetYPercent? } — follow another asset's resolved box; anchorEdge picks WHICH point on that box (default 'center'), then nudge by composition-space %.
  - { x, y } — raw composition-space pixels (backward-compatible passthrough; not the preferred form).
ignored for an item when the matching fromAssetId/toAssetId is set. Resolved to pixels by pass 2 before the renderer mounts.

anchorEdge.description: Only used with followAssetId. Which point on the followed asset's box to resolve to. Default 'center'.

strokeColor.description: Raw hex stroke color (default #EA3943 red). WavyLine doesn't tokenize color so an author can pick the exact curve hue on the fly without a theme entry.

strokeColorToken.description: Theme color token name; takes precedence over raw strokeColor when both are set.

curveAmount.description: Signed magnitude of the perpendicular control-point offset as a fraction of the segment length. 0 = straight line; 0.28 (default) makes a noticeable bow; negative flips the bow direction.

drawDurationFraction.description: fraction of the active window spent animating the dashoffset from full length to 0 (draw-in). Hold afterwards.

easing.description: easing token driving the draw-in spring entrance + opacity envelope
